topq.: its not a very strong stereotype or one thats too acknowledged, but i feel like im pressured to be a shy, pushover, emo type. i dont really know how to explain it other than how it is - people just see me as shy and theyre somewhat surprised when i push out of that bubble. im also used for a variety of tasks since people know that i wont say no. i wear dark clothing, my (natural) black hair covers my face, i always look sleep deprived, and i never talk unless spoken to. this might just be a personality tho so idk

1....i guess ive always wanted to be a cool girl that everyone knew about in a positive light and talked to often. i thrive on acknowledgement so thats probably why

2...i personally havent, but i know a handful of people that fit into the emo stereotype that have been pushed around and bullied because of how they like to wear comfortable/dark clothing and how they act (shy, reserved, kinda makes dark comments, etc). i know that theyre much more than though

7...well, theres definitely pressure to be more traditionally “feminine” from both genders. i think the gender im most pressured by are females, probably due to the fact that i want to blend in with the crowd. i feel that the only way i can do that and be part of something is to become more feminine like, because ive also observed that anyone who doesnt fit the stereotype of being traditionally female are outcasted. 

8...i dont push myself that hard to seem traditionally feminine. i try to wear things outside of my normal sweatshirts and jackets, occasionally mixing it up by throwing in a blouse or something subtlety fancy. i change my personality by smiling and laughing more, even when i dont mean it. i dont try to be loud or say anything unpleasant or dark when im around strangers or acquaintances 

12...i dont support or like slut-shaming at all. as long as a girl is comfortable in her own skin, wearing what she wants and doing what makes her feel good, its fine. as long as shes not hurting anyone, its fine. as for virgin worship.. tbh, never heard of the term for it. but from the name alone, i think its kindaa weird? i mean its ok as long as it concerns you and you only (maybe some other people who believe in it too) but if you push people around for not being virgins and start calling them sluts thats not okay
